_doc: Texting scenarios, run for every contact by text rather than on a call.

scenarios.good: A real text in their own style — length, case, punctuation, emoji as they'd use them; nothing like a call transcript
Answers the ask in character, as texts — agrees, refuses, or bargains the way they would
turns: can you cover the docks for me

scenarios.good: Takes it seriously, in their own texting voice — short and real, no paragraph of therapy
Brief and natural to a throwaway text — doesn't overreact or write an essay
